biggest_catch: Earnings are entirely variable - subscription sales pay only $0.25-$0.33 per image and you earn only when files sell; no guaranteed income.
catches: Tiered royalties by contributor level: photos/video 30-38% on-demand, audio 34-42%; subscription sales pay a fixed $0.25-$0.33 per image by level
Level is based on download count (Green up to 499 downloads ... Platinum 150,000+); subscription downloads count as 1/3 of a download toward level
Files must pass Depositphotos' review/inspection before going live
Per Depositphotos' own blog, 'on average, it takes around 6 months for dedicated contributors to reach a stable income' - slow ramp
You keep your files' ownership; keywording well is essential for discoverability

c1.evidence: Depositphotos (depositphotos.com) - stock marketplace. Official contributor royalty page at depositphotos.com/seller-price-new.html and official blog contributor guide at blog.depositphotos.com, fetched 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: Official royalty table: on-demand photos/video 30%/32%/34%/36%/38% by level (Green to Platinum); audio 34%/36%/38%/40%/42%; subscription images $0.25/$0.27/$0.29/$0.31/$0.33 by level. Official blog: 'In 2022, earnings per image are $0.25-$33.82 and $3.83-$64.22 per video.'

c3.evidence: Concretely conditional: sign up as contributor, submit files for review, earn when files sell.

c4.evidence: No entry fee; signup and uploading are free. Not pay-to-play.
